name: thaddius
_comment: Solo-raid Thaddius. `.rjson pull` sends each bot climbing to its assigned add via move_to_target (the only shape that paths UP the ramp -- a normal MoveTo snaps Z into the slime below). Roles split LEFT/Stalagg vs RIGHT/Feugen; healers split 1/2 via the `split` field so neither tank goes unhealed. add targeting + Magnetic Pull swaps are the attack shape (detect+select:nearest, sticky:false); polarity is stack_point by charge; twin-add death-sync is target_hp_ahead + @damage. the add-phase gate is the is_alive shape (either add alive, threat-based/no-LOS); C++ owns only the z-drop transition. See BossNotes/Thaddius.md and RAID_AI_JSON_AUTHORING.md (move_to_target) for the full rationale.

rules._comment: Pull: main tank climbs toward the live Stalagg (left platform). No attack -- C++ engages on arrival. `then` re-climbs to whichever add it lands on after a Magnetic Pull swap. boss:"" so the rule goes inert when the add dies.
Pull: off-tank climbs toward the live Feugen (right platform). No attack -- C++ engages on arrival. `then` gives it the same Magnetic Pull swap recovery as the main tank.
Pull: ranged DPS (ranged,!healer) climb toward Stalagg (left), stopping ~5y short, then hand off to the C++ ranged anchor.
Pull: first half of the healer bots climb to Stalagg (left) so the main-tank side is healed. split counts bots only (humans excluded). No attack -- climb then heal.
Pull: second half of the healer bots climb to Feugen (right) so the off-tank side is healed.
Pull: melee DPS climb toward Feugen (right). role melee,!tank,!healer so tanks/healers (also 'melee' since IsMelee == !IsRanged) don't match and ping-pong.

Add phase: attack the nearest living add. detect+select:nearest with sticky:false rides Magnetic Pull -- a tank flung to the other add retargets to it instead of running back. Replaces the C++ targeting + on-platform anchors. boss:"" so it yields when both adds die.
Transition (both adds dead): C++ jump down from the add platforms (z312) to the low platform (z304).

Thaddius phase polarity (Level-2): negative-charge melee stack at their left anchor; yields once parked so the rotation runs. self_aura gates on the Polarity Shift debuff. (The 3 rules below are the other charge/role anchors.)

suppress._comment: Pull window: suppress follow + formation so the autonomous climb owns movement instead of bots being yanked back to the master.
Add phase (is_alive: either add alive, threat-based/no-LOS): no formation / follow / generic assist while the attack shape owns targeting.

Add phase (after 5s): suppress all class taunts. Magnetic Pull transfers threat in the boss script, so re-taunts aren't needed and paladin taunts (Hand of Reckoning, Righteous Defense) steal across platforms. The 5s grace lets the opening pickup fire. Name the class actions, not just 'taunt spell' (which paladins/DKs alias).

Thaddius phase (boss attackable): suppress every non-rotation movement so nothing shoves bots off the polarity stack once stack_point parks and yields. 'dps assist' left on so bots still DPS between Polarity Shifts; auto-attacks unaffected. encounter_active gates the whole boss phase (he's non-attackable until then).
Death-sync: zero a bot's non-healing damage casts while its add is <=40% HP and the other is >=3% higher, so the two adds die within the ~5s revive window. Self-deactivates once the adds are dead.
